- "Critical" is a separate flag from negative polarity. 70.6% critical alongside 25.8% negative means critical is not the same as negative [c1]. I cannot say from this data what makes an article critical.
- Themes (lift over corpus share) [c1]:
  - Subcategories: GPUs (3.5% share, lift 320.7), semiconductor industry updates (5.3%, lift 92.8), AI advancements (7.6%, lift 34.6), earnings and financial reports (2.1%, lift 79.8).
